title: Pilot availability call
text:
Recruiter: Which schedules work for you?
Alex Morgan: Available weekends and early starts. Based in Austin, open to relocating to Dallas. Not available for overnight shifts.

title: Aircraft maintenance follow-up
text:
Sam Rivera: My aircraft maintenance contract finishes in four weeks. Interested in permanent work in Texas.
Recruiter: We will confirm certifications before submitting your profile.

title: Ground operations screening
text: Jordan Lee: Looking for ground operations work near Denver. Available to start in two weeks and happy with weekend shifts. Cannot relocate at the moment.
